Methods

Init()

Called when the tab is showed after using the 'Next' button.
Meant to initialize the current step after completing the previous one.
void Init()

Revert()

Called when the tab is hidden after using the 'Back' button, or when the pop-up is closed.
Meant to clean the current step data and the Builder data before returning to the previous step.
You should use this to undo any modifications to the Builder made in Step(). 
void Revert()

Step()

Called when the tab is hidden after using either the 'Next' button or the 'OK' button.
Meant to pass the entered data from the current step to the BundleBuilder before continuing to the next step.
void Step()

StepBack()

Called when the tab is showed after using the 'Back' button.
Serves as a light initialization after cancelling the later step.
void StepBack()
